name: loopfinder
description: Find the feedback loops in your personal workspace: run your scripts with writes blocked, record what they read and write, add the human/AI steps by hand, and see every loop — including the ones you never declared.

scripts.demo: node bin/loopfinder.js build --config examples/demo/loopfinder/config.json && node bin/loopfinder.js serve --config examples/demo/loopfinder/config.json
